KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.

2. When practising upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   B. Copy random text without understanding upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.

3. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.

4. When practising nyakati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding nyakati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to nyakati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for nyakati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” nyakati.

5. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. zito
   B. nene
   C. pana
   D. fupi

6. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. kitoto
   B. mitoto
   C. watoto
   D. mato

7. When practising Usalama, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Usalama.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Usalama.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Usalama.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Usalama.

8. When practising Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Maagano.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maagano.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Maagano.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Maagano.

9. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.

10. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   B. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain nyakati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Usalama and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Maagano and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
